entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: Event in 4559 AR when Kruphix withdrew the gods of Theros from the Mortal Realm.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: God of horizons and knowledge who decreed the Silence.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who as a child came into possession of the god-forged sword.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God of the Forge who forged the sword.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God who reforged the sword into the spear Godsend.

entities.name: Godsend
entities.description: Spear reforged by Heliod that could wound even gods.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: Satyr planeswalker who ascended to godhood as God of Revels.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Met Elspeth on the Four Winds Plateau and named her Champion of Heliod.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: Goddess of the hunt who glimpsed Xenagos's plot.

entities.name: Polukranos
entities.description: Giant ten-headed hydra slain by Elspeth and Daxos.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: God who aided Cymede and killed Rhordon.

entities.name: Cymede
entities.description: Aided by Keranos raising the Deyda River.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: God who showed himself battling in the sky.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: God who healed Rhordon during the duel.

entities.name: Rhordon
entities.description: Minotaur duelist killed by Keranos's steam elemental.

events.summary: Elspeth comes into possession of a powerful sword forged by Purphoros; the gods grow paranoid, manipulated by Xenagos.
events.quote: each god was driven to paranoia and violence

events.summary: Elspeth meets Daxos on the Four Winds Plateau as the gods wage open war.
events.quote: the gods’ obsession with her led them to wage open war against each other

events.summary: Nylea glimpses Xenagos's plot too late to stop it.
events.quote: only Nylea , goddess of the hunt, glimpsed the true nature of Xenagos’s plot

events.summary: Kruphix decrees the Silence of the Gods, withdrawing the pantheon into Nyx; Xenagos ascends to godhood as God of Revels.
events.quote: He decreed the Silence of the Gods

events.summary: Elspeth and Daxos slay Polukranos, and Daxos names Elspeth the Champion of Heliod.
events.quote: Daxos named Elspeth the Champion of Heliod

events.summary: Some gods circumvent the Silence: Keranos aids Cymede, and Iroas and Mogis appear above the duel of Anax and Rhordon, where Keranos's steam elemental kills Rhordon.
events.quote: Keranos retaliated by creating a draconic steam elemental from the river

relations.quote: forcibly withdrawn from the Mortal Realm by Kruphix
manipulated further by the satyr planeswalker Xenagos
Elspeth and Daxos together were faced with the giant ten-headed hydra
which killed Rhordon and all his minotaur allies
